1.text: Aburamu amaze imyaka mirongo urwenda n'icyenda avutse, Uwiteka aramubonekera aramubwira ati “Ni jye Mana Ishoborabyose, ujye ugendera imbere yanjye kandi utungane rwose.

2.text: Nanjye ndasezerana isezerano ryanjye nawe, nzakugwiza cyane.”

4.text: “Dore isezerano ryanjye ubwanjye ndariguhaye, nawe uzaba sekuruza w'amahanga menshi.

5.text: Kandi ntuzitwa ukundi Aburamu, ahubwo wiswe Aburahamu kuko nkugize sekuruza w'amahanga menshi.

6.text: Kandi nzakororotsa cyane, nzatuma amahanga agukomokaho, n'abami bazagukomokaho.

7.text: “Kandi nzakomeza isezerano ryanjye nawe n'urubyaro rwawe ruzakurikiraho, rigeze ibihe byose, ribe isezerano rihoraho, kugira ngo nkubere Imana wowe n'urubyaro rwawe ruzakurikiraho.

8.text: Kandi wowe n'urubyaro rwawe ruzakurikiraho, nzabaha igihugu cy'ubusuhuke bwawe, igihugu cy'i Kanāni cyose kuba gakondo y'iteka, nanjye nzaba Imana yabo.”

9.text: Imana yongera kubwira Aburahamu iti “Nawe uzakomeze isezerano ryanjye, wowe n'urubyaro rwawe ruzakurikiraho kugeza ibihe byabo byose.

10.text: Iri ni ryo sezerano ryanjye muzakomeza, riri hagati yanjye namwe n'urubyaro rwawe ruzakurikiraho, umugabo wese muri mwe azakebwa.

11.text: Muzakebwa umunwa w'ibyo mwambariye, kizaba ikimenyetso cy'isezerano ryanjye namwe.

12.text: Umuhungu wese muri mwe uzaba amaze iminsi munani avutse azakebwa, bigeze ibihe by'ingoma zanyu zose. Uzaba avukiye mu rugo rwawe, cyangwa utari uwo mu rubyaro rwawe waguzwe n'ifeza n'abanyamahanga,

13.text: uvukira mu rugo rwawe n'uwaguzwe igiciro bakwiriye gukebwa, kandi isezerano ryanjye rizaba ku mibiri yanyu, ribe isezerano rihoraho.

14.text: Kandi umugabo utakebwe umunwa w'icyo yambariye azakurwa mu bwoko bwe, azaba yishe isezerano ryanjye.”

15.text: Imana yongera kubwira Aburahamu iti “Sarayi umugore wawe ntukamwite ukundi Sarayi, ahubwo ujye umwita Sara.

16.text: Nanjye nzamuha umugisha kandi nzaguha umwana w'umuhungu kuri we. Nzamuha umugisha koko kandi azaba nyirakuruza w'amahanga, abami b'amahanga bazakomoka kuri we.”

17.text: Maze Aburahamu arubama, araseka aribaza ati “Mbese umwana azabyarwa n'umaze imyaka ijana avutse? Kandi na Sara umaze imyaka mirongo urwenda, azabyara?”

18.text: Aburahamu abwira Imana ati “Icyampa Ishimayeli akabaho, ari imbere yawe!”

19.text: Imana iramusubiza iti “Ahubwo Sara umugore wawe ni we uzabyaraho umuhungu, uzamwite Isaka. Nanjye nzakomeza isezerano ryanjye na we, ngo ribere urubyaro ruzakurikiraho isezerano ridashira.

20.text: Kandi ibya Ishimayeli ndakumviye: dore muhaye umugisha, nzamwororotsa mugwize cyane, azabyara abatware cumi na babiri kandi nzamuhindura ubwoko bukomeye.

21.text: Ariko isezerano ryanjye nzarikomeza na Isaka, uwo uzabyarana na Sara mu gihe nk'iki cy'umwaka utaha, kuko ari icyo nashyizeho.”

22.text: Imana irorera kuvugana na we, irazamuka, iva aho Aburahamu ari.

23.text: Aburahamu ajyana Ishimayeli umuhungu we, n'abandi bose bavukiye mu rugo rwe, n'abo yaguze ifeza ze, umugabo wese w'abo mu rugo rwe, abakeba kuri uwo munsi uko Imana yari yamutegetse.

24.text: Aburahamu yari amaze imyaka mirongo urwenda n'icyenda avutse, ubwo yakebwaga umunwa w'icyo yambariye.

25.text: Ishimayeli umuhungu we yari amaze imyaka cumi n'itatu, ubwo yakebwaga.

26.text: Ku munsi umwe Aburahamu akebanwa n'umuhungu we Ishimayeli.

27.text: N'abagabo bose bo mu rugo rwe, abaruvukiyemo n'abo yaguze n'abanyamahanga, bakebanwa na we.
